stable-EP.lineage: direction_detector real Gaussian EP cavity moment matching; new standalone stabilized implementation
stable-EP.equations: Hreal=[[ReH,-ImH],[ImH,ReH]], sigma_real=sigma_complex/2; lambda_cav=1/diag(V)-lambda_site; eta_cav=m/diag(V)-gamma_site; rawLLR=2*a*eta_cav; tiltedmean=a*tanh(rawLLR/2)
stable-EP.precision_guard: retain both old site parameters when proposed precision<=0 or>1e12; record rejected sites; no jitter or alternate detector
stable-EP.returned_variance: actual discrete tilted variance; site floor not returned as posterior uncertainty
stable-EP.linear_solve: real2N float64 Cholesky/solve and covariance diagonal via inverse; requested torch CPU/CUDA device actually used
stable-EP.failure: nonfinite/invalid Cholesky/cavity precision below-1e-8/linear residual>1e-8 raises
stable-EP.cost: N1024 uses2048-dimensional dense factorization per iteration; quote one case before qualification batch

QPSK-MF.lineage: independent finite-discrete mean-field variational coordinate descent, not Gaussian EP or EP site reparameterization
QPSK-MF.objective: E_q||y-Hx||^2/sigma + sum_j,sum_bit q_j(bit) log q_j(bit); factorized real/imag BPSK marginals
QPSK-MF.update: ascending coordinate: residual excludes current symbol; raw conditional LLR real/imag=4*a*Re/Im(h_j^H residual_excluding_j)/sigma; damp discrete marginal means
QPSK-MF.initialization: matched single-user discrete marginals; exact on orthogonal columns
QPSK-MF.output: LLR from final variational marginal probabilities; NEVER Gaussian-demap discrete variance
QPSK-MF.cost: fixed20/40 sweeps; one update per symbol per sweep; torch CPU/CUDA device matches request
QPSK-MF.limitation: factorization omits posterior correlations; fixed point need not be global optimum

interface.truth_access: none; caller supplied frozen H must be lineage-tagged estimated/oracle outside this API
interface.sigma: total complex variance; each real component sigma/2
interface.bit_order: all real bits then all imaginary bits
interface.LLR: log P0/P1; clip20 only after marginal moments
interface.state: fresh each call; no posterior/site caches; CUDA device recorded with resolved index
interface.calls: each terminal invocation incl LDPC charged1T; doubling is a second T

qualification.exact_toys: all8 recipes: diagonal complex/orthogonal and zero/unobserved-column QPSK exact LLR+mu+var rtol/atol1e-8; coupledN2/N4 exact enumeration differences retained, not falsely required to be zero
qualification.invariants: finite outputs, real variance>=0, unit conventions, MF free-energy monotonicity, EP solve residual, short real LDPC bit recovery

fixed_doubling.cache_rule: first4 preregistered engineering cached terminal states, same frozen y/H/sigma per pair; no adaptive replacement
fixed_doubling.decoded: identical every bit; stronger than merely equal FER
fixed_doubling.EP_extra: final rejected sites must be zero
fixed_doubling.failure: retain original outputs and unqualified status; no tolerance widening/repeated rescue
fixed_doubling.identity: Same resolved device, recipe, frozen y/H/sigma/constellation and actual LDPC G/H/free_cols/check-node edges/row pointers and maxiter. Nonfinite residuals rejected.

qualification.sequence: small toys first; one N1024 engineering case for resource quote; authorize/freeze finite64T resources before remaining qualification
qualification.sufficiency: numerical correctness and iteration stability establish limited qualification, not superiority; development performance gate still required

development.legacy_comparators: retain old BP and EP10 results separately; additional calls require their own explicit budget, not hidden in1536
